name: @dxkjailbreak/dsh-redteam-results
description: Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.
author: dxk
